name: A free feat at 1st level
author: Alexandria
summary: Every character starts with one feat they qualify for, on top of their class and background.

rules.text: Every character gains **one feat** at 1st level that they meet the prerequisites for, in addition to anything from their background or species.

assistant.gm: Each character takes one extra feat at 1st level (prerequisites apply). When helping make a character, offer a feat that fits the build.
assistant.player: At this table each character gets one free feat at 1st level (it must meet the prerequisites). Suggest feats that fit their class and play style.
